title: Restricting an integer multiplicity triple to a Borel sub-carrier with smaller positive multiplicity
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P, and let R = (C, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n). Let C' ⊆ C be Borel, and let θ' : ℝ^P → ℕ be measurable with 0 < θ'(x) ≤ θ(x) for every x ∈ C'. Assume that, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ C', every approximate tangent space of C at x is an approximate tangent space of C' at x: for all Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C' x Q. Then there is an integer multiplicity triple R' in U with carrier C', multiplicity θ' and orientation ξ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U C' : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (θ' : Euclid P → ℕ), MeasurableSet C' → C' ⊆ R.carrier → Measurable θ' → (∀ x ∈ C', 0 < θ' x) → (∀ x ∈ C', θ' x ≤ R.mult x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict C'), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n R.carrier x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C' x Q) → ∃ R' : IMRep U n, R'.carrier = C' ∧ R'.mult = θ' ∧ R'.orient = R.orient
